description.value: The Kebob House is an authentic Persian grill in Port Coquitlam serving kebob combos with saffron basmati rice or side salad and grilled tomato. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, making it a sit-down option for cyclists passing through the Shaughnessy Street corridor. It is a locally operated spot with a focused Persian menu rather than a generic fast-food chain.

address.value: 2865 Shaughnessy Street, Port Coquitlam, BC V3C 3H1
